draft.shortGloss: to bring; to fetch; to bring about
draft.emotion: helpful and eager, handing something over to someone
notes: Although transitive in meaning, लाना behaves like an intransitive verb in past/perfective tenses and never takes ने (e.g., वह पानी लाया, not उसने पानी लाया).
Contrast with ले जाना (to take away to another place).

senses.definition: To take or carry something or someone to the speaker or to a specified place.

examples.text: कृपया मेरे लिए एक गिलास पानी लाओ।
examples.translation: Please bring me a glass of water.

senses.definition: To cause a state, change, or result to happen.
